about.text: Chinese third-party game-data platform (Laoyuegou) covering League of Legends, Dota 2, World of Warcraft, Heroes of the Storm, Diablo 3 and StarCraft 2: records game career (time, wins, performance), big-data analysis, per-game reviews, guild/team pages, an app, friend matching and live hot topics; site footer 2012-2016.
